James Shaw privacy statement

Privacy Statement

This privacy statement applies to personal and other information provided to the office of James Shaw, List MP, and Minister for Climate Change, Minister for Statistics and Associate Minister for Finance.

Names and email addresses provided to the office of James Shaw will be used only for the purpose of sending a regular email update/newsletter about the Minister’s responsibilities as Minister for Climate Change, and will not be disclosed to any other parties, except where authorised by law.
